name: Eels Stewed à l'American
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: eels, skinned, cleaned, and fat removed from inside
ingredients.originalText: Three pounds eels, skinned, cleaned, and fat removed from inside

instructions.text: Cut the eels in pieces, about two inches in length
Season and lay in a saucepan containing the melted butter
Strew the onion and parsley over all
Cover the saucepan closely, and set in a pot of cold water
Bring this gradually to a boil, then cook very gently for an hour and a half, or until the eels are tender
Turn out into a deep dish

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut the eels in pieces, about two inches in length
2. Season and lay in a saucepan containing the melted butter
3. Strew the onion and parsley over all
4. Cover the saucepan closely, and set in a pot of cold water
5. Bring this gradually to a boil, then cook very gently for an hour and a half, or until the eels are tender
6. Turn out into a deep dish
